response.overview: This is the third and final HBO special by Red Skelton and was taped live at Hamilton Place in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. Skelton performed several mime skits including a grandfather teaching baseball to his grandson, a woman driver, a veterinarian giving a flu shot to a whale, and a father viewing his new baby for the first time at the maternity ward window. Red also performed Clem Kaddidlehopper as an Irish tenor.
response.title: Red Skelton's Funny Faces III
